system.description:
Double Pane: When you create an Ice Mirror, you instead create 2, instead of 1 and your mirrors have immunity to Poison Damage.

Truth in Passing: You gain a rank of Mastery to Investigation. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. When you take the Study action, you can complete it as an Action, instead of 1 minute.

Frostbane: When you inflict the Frostbite condition on a creature within 10 feet of an Ice Mirror, you can force the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are dragged into the Ice Mirrors, and then expelled from another active Ice Mirrors, falling prone into a space within 5 feet of the Ice Mirrors they were expelled from.
